data_description.prompt: Alfred's personality and rules. Supports templates.
data_description.llm_hass_api: Assist lets Alfred read and control the entities you have exposed. Alfred admin adds tools for the error log, automations, scripts and bug reports; it only works for administrators.
data_description.chat_model: Haiku is fastest and cheapest; Sonnet and Opus handle more complex requests.
data_description.effort: How hard Claude thinks before answering. Low keeps voice replies snappy.
data_description.web_search: Lets Alfred look things up online (news, opening hours, general knowledge). Billed per search.
data_description.github_token: Optional. A fine-grained token with Issues read and write access lets Alfred admin report bugs as GitHub issues.
data_description.github_repo: Where bug reports go, as owner/name.
